Define a series of parallel horizontal slicing planes intersecting the volume bounding box.
Iterate through each slice plane from the light source direction toward the receiver.
Accumulate the computed light intensity into the output buffer for the current slice.
Finalize the image from the accumulated intensities of all slices.
